name: Boku to 4-nin no Onna Kyoushi
source:
Shun is a high school student. He has a regular head but looks weak and he is prissy. That is why he is sometimes teased by other students. However, he is living a peaceful life at school. But his peaceful life is destroyed by a new teacher Kasumi, beautiful and pure. He gets stiff when she is around and can't move even his tongue. When he knows Kasumi is engaged to Yoshio who is the worst teacher at school, the story starts to ....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
舜是一名高中生。他头脑正常，但看起来很虚弱，而且很拘谨。这就是为什么他有时会被其他学生取笑。然而，他在学校过着平静的生活。但他平静的生活却被美丽纯洁的新老师霞破坏了。当她在身边时，他会变得僵硬，甚至连舌头都无法动弹。当他知道霞与学校里最差老师的吉雄订婚时，故事开始了……

[来自工口游戏商店]
